'''Apotropaic''' ({{G|Apotropaic}}) means "turning away evil". Matcha Flavoured uses the word for things that protect against the undead: [[warding]] charms, [[Silver Bullion|silver]], holy weapons and the healing arrows sold by the fletcher. In tooltips, the {{G|Apotropaic}} glyph marks the maximum level of warding.

== Apotropaic Max ==
The full set of [[Electrum equipment|electrum armor]] lists {{G|Apotropaic}} Max under its set bonus. This is {{G|Warding}} 4, the highest warding level, which held items can't reach on their own.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/electrum_helmet.json}}</ref> At {{G|Warding}} 4 the wearer:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/warding/power_4.mcfunction}}</ref>
* gives every undead mob within 24 blocks Slowness III every 0.5 seconds, husks included,
* deals {{Hp|2}} every 0.5 seconds to the nearest undead mob within 12 blocks, or to the [[Wither]] within 16 blocks,
* pierces the protection of mobs wearing copper armor, dealing {{Hp|1}} to them.
See [[Warding]] for the full comparison of levels.
